entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: Queen of Akros on Theros, devoted follower of Keranos, skilled warrior and seer.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: City-state ruled by Cymede and Anax.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God of storms whom Cymede served.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: King of Akros, husband of Cymede.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Worked with Cymede to raise the Deyda River.

entities.name: Deyda River
entities.description: River raised to flood the minotaur encampment.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Cymede was compleated.

events.summary: Cymede offers herself to Keranos in exchange for his help during the siege of Akros; he turns the river into an elemental that consumes the minotaurs.
events.quote: Cymede offered herself to Keranos in exchange for his assistance.

events.summary: Cymede is claimed by Keranos and ascends into Nyx as a pillar of fire and crimson light.
events.quote: Cymede was claimed by Keranos as she transformed into a pillar of fire and crimson light

events.summary: Cymede is compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Cymede was compleated .

relations.quote: was the queen of Akros on Theros , a devoted follower of Keranos and wife of Anax
